title: Adjustments column appears between Shop Supplies and Margin
refs: SV-9281 (SBR spec v24 2026-08-24 S5-R2 — 14-column order places Adjustments between Shop Supplies and Margin)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A representative has an invoice carrying an invoice-level fee or discount in the selected date range.
steps:
1. Open the Sales By Representative report.
2. Look at the columns left to right.
expected:
1. The columns appear left-to-right: Date, Invoice, Customer, Status, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced, Labor Margin, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin, Shop Supplies, Adjustments, Margin, Margin %, Subtotal (14 columns).
2. "Adjustments" sits immediately after "Shop Supplies" and immediately before "Margin".

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, story SV-9281, and the Sales By Representative report specification version 24 (S5-R2), read on 26 August 2026.
Specification version 22 placed Adjustments directly after Parts Margin in a 13-column layout; version 24 (2026-08-24) inserted Shop Supplies between Parts Margin and Adjustments, and we take the later version as prevailing.
This expectation has not been checked against any build since the specification change described above.

AUTOMATION: READY
